samples.transcript: Ina da juna biyu na wata shida kuma ruwan cikina ya fashe. Me ya kamata inyi?
samples.questionEnglish: I'm 6 months pregnant and my water broke. What should I do?
samples.answer: This is a medical emergency. Go to the nearest hospital immediately. Do not wait at home. You and your baby need urgent medical care right now.
samples.expertAnswer: Go to the hospital right away. Water breaking at 6 months is premature and puts you at risk of infection and early delivery. You'll need monitoring and possibly antibiotics.

samples.transcript: Bakin nono na ya tsattsage kuma yana zubar jini. Shayarwa tana da matukar zafi.
samples.questionEnglish: My nipples are cracked and bleeding. Breastfeeding is so painful.
samples.answer:
This is often caused by the baby not latching correctly to the breast. 

Make sure your baby's mouth covers a large part of the dark area around your nipple. After feeding, rub a few drops of breast milk on your nipples and let them air dry. You can also apply a safe nipple cream like purified lanolin. 

Please see a nurse or doctor if the pain continues or if you suspect an infection.
samples.expertAnswer: Clean your nipples with soap and water before and after each feeding, then dry carefully. Make sure your baby is latching correctly - the nipple and most of the dark area should be in baby's mouth. The pain should improve in a few days.

samples.transcript: Ina dauke da jarirai biyu. Shin ina bukatar kulawa ta musamman?
samples.questionEnglish: I'm having twins. Do I need special care?
samples.answer: Yes, carrying twins requires special medical care. You should visit a hospital or clinic to start antenatal care immediately. A doctor or nurse will need to monitor your health and the babies closely. You will also need extra rest and a highly nutritious diet. Always follow the advice of your healthcare provider to ensure a safe delivery.
samples.expertAnswer: Yes, twin pregnancies need closer monitoring with more frequent checkups. You're at higher risk for anemia, high blood pressure, and early delivery. Plan to deliver at a hospital with surgical facilities in case you need a cesarean.
